notes.title: Small Update (Mar 24th)
notes.notes:
It's me again, it's time for weekly update. Important QoL changes for this update:
[list][*]You can now upgrade your bag to 40 slots.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35801251/e2801625b81c53a7124270bb837c1fd78d36c53a.png[/img]
[*]I added a special bag called "Tool Bag" which you can send your tool to it by pressing "T" by default.
This is essential for newcomer because item slots are limited at the beginning of the game. You don't have to run around the Storage to exchange tools.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35801251/7d323fba50e6b787f2dcf213d1bf84bb56b90141.png[/img]
[*]You can now remove fish trap when you accidentally place it somewhere you don't want.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35801251/3610b5ecfc12bb289361a13bea8cbdef5b107365.png[/img]
[*]I knew the fishing mechanic is hard for some people so I just added an option to turn it off. Please look into the settings.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35801251/d5a28b0248025044a8eb476682f08764c2acf591.png[/img]
[*]Sickle can also use to clear out immature crops.
[*]Fixed a bug that made your pet spawn at black spots of your house.
[*]Fixed craft & cooking material/ingredient consumtion bugs. (It won't take more material/ingredient to make multiple item)
[*]Fixed help window in shop somtimes show empty info.
[*]Speed up gameplay on 30 FPS locked computers. (Experimentally)
[/list]

Thank you for reading and have a wonderful day!

notes.title: Small Update (Mar 18th)
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, hope you guys will have wonderful weekends. Just have some free time to revisit Peaceful Days to fix bugs and add QoL update.
[list]
[*]Player can cook multiple meals in the kitchen now.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35801251/54a351dd9791b0f9b622fa816bd08d60f6f560b9.png[/img]
[*]Increase the total life span of barn animal to 2.5 years. (This will help you maximize animal heart levels to collect better products before it's getting old and die.)
[/list]
Gonna add more small updates like this in the future. Looking forward to hearing more feedbacks in the future.

notes.title: September Update
notes.notes:
Hello, it's me again. I just want to say I love this community so much. Your kind words helped me get through a difficult time.
These are the thing I have been doing in September.
[list]
[*]House Upgrade
The old house was hard to implement so I just created a new one. Added quest for a free house upgrade and other cool stuff.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35801251/f942e002885de236060df3d9d30eeeb694950df5.gif[/img]
[*]Inventory
Okay, now you can have multiple stacks of the same item. And you can swap things in your bag too!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35801251/7bb1dfe39fee8d4c9c7bef877d87edb213d00bae.gif[/img]
[*]Bee & Honey
The old system was boring, so I changed it. You can now plant trees around the hives. Each type of tree will give you a specific type of honey. The quality of the honey will also increase when you harvest.
Try to plant 3 different types of trees around one hive, and you will get Special Honey!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35801251/84d96296c0a88214847e179786bfd3ada6072bc0.png[/img]
[*]Exhibition Room
Robert had an idea to attract more people to the town so he asked you to complete the collection
of items...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35801251/efde40da7b7b79fb29b046ef6ce8f65a04e272bc.png[/img]
[*]Quick Save (WIP)
Yes, you can save without going back to your house now. But there are some limitations. 
Ex: Can't save in the Mine.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35801251/43f21963fee4aa8c0e6e7f1eb4c0c2629c2ee838.png[/img]
[*]Fence Gate
It's useful so I just added one.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35801251/7e9d54ef83daf0373946d766f2ecb7eaf93f0dce.gif[/img]
[*]Fixed a lotta bug that I don't even remember...
[/list]

This list could be longer but due to the storm hit my place and there was no electricity for 3 days.
Thanks for reading and have a good day!

notes.title: August Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I hope you had or will have a good day!
I'm sorry for not releasing any big update recently. I was having a bad time for months. My progress was slow but now I'm back with my highest productive!
Some information about new update.
[list]
[*]You can use Marlin service now.
[*]Added Faraway Island.
[*]Added Volcano Island.
[*]Balancing the game.
[*]Fixed various bugs.
[*][b]Added Felix's Heart Events[/b]
[previewyoutube=oHWyMDBfSeM;full][/previewyoutube]
[/list]

There are more to come soon! Have fun playing villagers!

- Nhat Nguyen

It's been a while since I last updated the game! I took note of every bug that you guys found and hopefully fixed all of them.
Besides the bug fixing, I also added 3 more festivals for Summer (Gonna add more for Autumn and Winter in the next patches)
I also added more mine floors and a useful item called: Teleport Ring

notes.title: Update 0.6.0
notes.notes:
It's been a while since I last updated the game. I was having some health issues for a few week ago but I'm still working on the game :P
The update bring some Qol update as well as adding more contents and bug fixings.
Here is a list of the changes:
[list]
[*] Added more mine floors, mineral stones, puzzles.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35801251/3a2af237f4ecaf1c27544e65c49f2af54f89edbd.png[/img]
[*] Improved mouse system. Now the game will show item name
  when your hover on the hot bar and show NPC name
  when you hover on them in the minimap.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35801251/5e5d21520653f69936871845f28204f3dad6159e.gif[/img]
[*] Added "Animal Flute". With this flute, you
  can make your animal happier (Have 50% chance to give 
  addition products). (Still need more testing)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35801251/492fdde9fa6f0edaff89d454d7912935c691a01f.gif[/img]
[*] Fixed a bug that make upgraded sickle bug only harvest 
  one crop.
[*] Can now unequip tool when you select that tool again on the hot bar.
[*] Fixed time-base events bug.
[*] Fixed a bug that can make you can't move when finish 
  loading the game.
[*] Added mouse support for name choosing scene.
[*] Fixed a lot of minor bugs.
[/list]
